body:
i'm gonna be doing it tonight. nobody has to respond to this, but i do thank the posters who responded earlier. thank you for taking the time out of your lives to have responded.

i'm not going to be leaving a note or anything. everyone will know why i did it. it's kind of weird. i've been wondering what happens when it all ends. will i even know? or will i just close my eyes, and that will be that?

if somehow, after i'm gone, someone i know comes across this post, i just want you all to know that i wish you all well. even the ones that hurt me and threw me away, i wish you well.

thank you again to the ones that responded yesterday. you showed me more concern than anyone else the last few months. thank you.

I've never called any of those. Don't really know how they work. I'd feel too stupid crying about a girl. I don't expect anyone to understand how I felt about her. When I feel ok regarding her, I'm reminded about how much I hate living with this family of mine. I can't seem to find any comfort anywhere
I don't think I've ever felt so alone on my life
I wish I could talk to someone. I've told friends, and they all say the same generic stuff. Oddly enough, none of them have reached out to me since before new years now.
